title: Representability of pro-etale local systems of sets
statement: Let $X$ be a locally Noetherian scheme [def-pc-scheme, pqf-def-locnoeth], with small pro-etale site $X_{\mathrm{proet}}$ in the universes of [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site]. Let $F$ be a sheaf of sets on this site. Suppose that there is a pro-etale covering family $\{U_i\to X\}_i$ and sets $S_i$ such that $F|_{U_i}$ is isomorphic to the sheafification of the constant presheaf with value $S_i$ [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf]. Then there exist a scheme $Z$, an etale morphism $q:Z\to X$ [def-weil-etale-morphism], and bijections $\theta_U:F(U)\xrightarrow{\sim}\operatorname{Hom}_X(U,Z)$ natural in all objects $U\to X$ of $X_{\mathrm{proet}}$. The morphism $q$ has the following valuation lifting property. For every valuation ring $R$ [def-trf-valuation-ring] with fraction field $K$, every morphism $b:\operatorname{Spec}R\to X$, and every $X$-morphism $a:\operatorname{Spec}K\to Z$ over the restriction of $b$, there is a unique $X$-morphism $\widetilde a:\operatorname{Spec}R\to Z$ whose restriction to $\operatorname{Spec}K$ is $a$. No finiteness or nonemptiness condition is imposed on the sets $S_i$ or on $Z$.
